results.title: Priyanka Chopra Seeks Blessings At Siddhivinayak Temple In Mumbai, Waves At Fans- VIDEO
results.description: Priyanka Chopra sought blessings at Mumbai’s Siddhivinayak Temple on Monday. The actress opted for a traditional look for the visit, wearing an elegant pink suit with her hair left open
